title: The Night the Sky Said Hello
subtitle: Four mysterious friends meet on one rainy night, in six cinematic comic pages.

pages.alt: Page 1: A stormy night, Barsaat splashes into being, sees a funny reflection, and spots an orange spark.
Page 2: Agni makes a soft splash, meets Barsaat, and discovers a glowing path with him.
Page 3: Noor floats out of the storm and leads Barsaat and Agni up the hill.
Page 4: Aarav rolls into the story, stops a boulder, and meets the other three.
Page 5: The four friends work together to guide a magical raindrop safely through the stream.
Page 6: The four friends celebrate their first adventure as the storm clears at sunrise.
